answers.how: Measured the diameter of the Callisto model as 8 pixels. Calculated the prior's speed by tracking Callisto's position over 3.25 seconds, finding it travels an arc of 45.4 degrees on its 426-pixel radius orbit, resulting in a speed of 103.8 px/s. With the given speed of 0.627 m/s, the scale is 0.00604 m/px. 8 px * 0.00604 m/px = 0.0483 m.
